bounded_correctness_fixes: Lifecycle group keys are now derived from explicit wallet_id, condition_id, token_id, and outcome fields instead of trusting a precomputed string.
Deterministic ordering now includes dedupe_key, raw_payload_hash, source_endpoint_name, and source_fetch_timestamp as additional stable tie-breakers.
full_exit_count_explanation: No group with both BUY and SELL rows has exact equality between total bought size and total sold size. Near-flat residuals remain partial exits under the current exact-size policy.
known_limitations: one-page public smoke history can omit prior buys or later sells
REDEEM and resolution rows are not handled
mark-to-market and realized PnL are not computed
copyability delay, liquidity, fill priority, and queue position are unavailable
suspicious_observations: Several partial exits are near-flat by small residual sizes and may require a future explicit precision policy.
The two oversold bounded-history groups are XRP Up/Down rows, not BTC/ETH/SOL rows.
